name: 見積り方法と補助ルールの管理パネル
prompt:
Edit image1 LH09-0082 with one targeted typography correction. Original crop image2 is authority for restrained optical weight; Japanese mock3 confirms regular Japanese text. Keep layout, all wording, unified white card, dividers, neutral1–7 scale selector, and original OFF/ON/ON switch states completely unchanged.
Only reduce ALL text except main「見積り」heading to true Meiryo REGULAR400 optical weight. In particular「作業の見積り」「等間隔（1〜7点）」「0点の見積りを許可」「見積りの範囲を拡張」「未見積りの作業を数える」must be thin regular, not semibold/bold; current strokes are about30% too heavy. Match the lighter regular stroke in original. Also body/helper should remain ordinary regular, not medium. Main「見積り」alone Bold20/28. Preserve exact text, font sizes/spacing/color, green active switches and gray OFF. No redesign, new elements or changed states.
reviewNotes: Targeted weight correction visually lighter. Unified panel, scale1–7, all complete Japanese rules and off/on/on states rechecked. White controls/forest active switches retained; exact font/geometry and actual policy behavior unproved; v1 preserved.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
